Class Game

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.GameDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

The core game class. Inherit this class, create a new instance of this class and call Run(params string[]) to start the game. Only one instance of the game should be created per application. A singleton Instance property will be set to the newly created game instance and will only allow one instance of the game to be created per application.

Remarks

Main Game loop call order:

  • LoadContent() - Called once.
  • BeginRun() - Called once.
  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) - Called every frame with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo)- Called every frame.
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • EndRun() - Called once.
  • UnloadContent() - Called once.
Fixed Game loop call order:
  • LoadContent() - Called once.
  • BeginRun() - Called once.
  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) - Called every frame with variable timing.
  • FixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) - Called in a fixed interval with fixed timing.
  • InterpolateFixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, float) - Called every frame with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo) - Called every frame.
  • EndRun() - Called once.
  • UnloadContent() - Called once.

FixedPhysicsEnabled

Gets whether the fixed physics update system is enabled.

public bool FixedPhysicsEnabled { get; }

Property Value

bool

Remarks

When true, the fixed update functions will be called at the FixedPhysicsFramerate. Fixed Update call order:

  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) with variable timing.
  • FixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) with fixed timing.
  • InterpolateFixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, float) with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo)
Unlocked Update call order:
  • Update(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo) with variable timing.
  • DrawGame(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawGameUI(ScreenInfo)
  • DrawUI(ScreenInfo)

This property is initialized automatically in the constructor. You need to create a game instance before accessing this property. ApplyBackup(int)

Applies a backup by copying the contents of SavegameBackupDirectoryPath/(Backup-XX) to the current savegame directory, overwriting its contents.

public bool ApplyBackup(int backupNumber)

Parameters

backupNumber int

The backup number to apply.

Returns

bool

True if the backup was applied successfully; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Requires IsSavegameBackupDirectoryValid to be true. When constructing the Game object, ensure that SaveDirectory and ApplicationName are set in GameSettings to create a valid savegame backup directory.

ApplyBackup(int, int, int)

Applies the previous backup based on the current backup number, total created backups, and maximum allowed backups. If maxBackups is less than or equal to 0, the previous backup will be applied or the backup 0 if the current is 0. I f maxBackups is greater than 0, than GetPreviousBackup(int, int) is used to determine the previous backup to apply. Otherwise, calculates the previous backup using GetPreviousBackup(int, int) and applies it.

public bool ApplyBackup(int currentBackupNumber, int createdBackups, int maxBackups)

Parameters

currentBackupNumber int

The current backup number.

createdBackups int

The total number of backups created.

maxBackups int

The maximum number of backups allowed. If less than or equal to 0, unlimited backups are allowed.

Returns

bool

True if the backup was applied successfully; otherwise, false.

Remarks

If successful, this function will overwrite the current savegame directory with the contents of the selected backup. Requires IsSavegameBackupDirectoryValid to be true. When constructing the Game object, ensure that SaveDirectory and ApplicationName are set in GameSettings to create a valid savegame backup directory.

CreateBackup(int)

Creates a backup of the current savegame directory at the specified backup number. Copies the contents of the savegame directory to a backup directory named "Backup-XX" in the savegame backup directory. Returns true if the backup was created successfully; otherwise, false.

public bool CreateBackup(int backupNumber)

Parameters

backupNumber int

The backup number to use for the backup directory.

Returns

bool

True if the backup was created successfully; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Requires IsSavegameBackupDirectoryValid to be true. When constructing the Game object, ensure that SaveDirectory and ApplicationName are set in GameSettings to create a valid savegame backup directory.

CreateBackup(int, int, int)

Creates a new backup of the current savegame directory. Increments the backup number, copies the savegame directory to a new backup directory, and returns the result along with the new backup number and updated count of created backups.

public (bool success, int newBackupNumber, int createdBackups) CreateBackup(int currentBackupNumber, int createdBackups, int maxBackups)

Parameters

currentBackupNumber int

The current backup number.

createdBackups int

The total number of backups created so far.

maxBackups int

The maximum number of backups allowed. If less than or equal to 0, unlimited backups are allowed.

Returns

(bool success, int newBackupNumber, int createdBackups)

A tuple containing:

  • success: True if the backup was created successfully; otherwise, false.
  • newBackupNumber: The new backup number after incrementing.
  • createdBackups: The updated total number of backups created.

Remarks

Backups are stored in "SavegameBackupDirectoryPath/Backup-XX" based on the backup number. Requires IsSavegameBackupDirectoryValid to be true. When constructing the Game object, ensure that SaveDirectory and ApplicationName are set in GameSettings to create a valid savegame backup directory.

DrawCursorGame(ScreenInfo)

Draws the cursor in the game world space.

protected virtual void DrawCursorGame(ScreenInfo gameInfo)

Parameters

gameInfo ScreenInfo

Information about the game screen area, including dimensions and mouse position in game coordinates.

Remarks

This method is called every frame when the mouse is on screen and can be overridden in derived classes to implement custom cursor rendering in the game world. If not overridden, no cursor will be drawn in the game world.

public bool LoadSavegameSlotInformation(out int activeSlot, out int usedSlots, out int maxSlots)

Parameters

activeSlot int

Outputs the index of the currently active savegame slot.

usedSlots int

Outputs the number of savegame slots currently in use.

maxSlots int

Outputs the maximum number of savegame slots available.

Returns

bool

True if the information was successfully loaded; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Loads the information from a file named "CurrentSavegameSlot.txt" in the SavegameDirectoryPath. Requires IsSavegameDirectoryValid to be true. When constructing the Game object, ensure that SaveDirectory and ApplicationName are set in GameSettings to create a valid savegame backup directory.
